articles.summary: Phreesia has been named to Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026 list of “Revenue Cycle Management Companies to Know.” The annual list recognizes companies that play a critical role in helping healthcare organizations manage the growing complexity of revenue cycle operations, including patient access, intake, billing and reimbursement
articles.title: Phreesia Named to Becker’s Hospital Review’s 2026 List of “Revenue Cycle Management Companies to Know”
